sloka: ऊचुः च मुदिता रामम् सर्वे प्रांजलयः तदा ।इमे च परमोदार किंकराः तव राघव ॥१-२७-२५॥
transliteration: ūcuḥ ca muditā rāmam sarve prāṁjalayaḥ tadā ।ime ca paramodāra kiṁkarāḥ tava rāghava ॥1-27-25॥

translations.english: Rama received the astras he felt with his hands and commanded them saying, "Live in my mind" (serve me whenever I remember you).
